claims.general_denominator_alternatives: The exact row-degree condition gives the three stated valuation alternatives outside the two leading-constant primes; root-free leading diagonal and leading-s coefficient force both parameters integral.
claims.exact_Q26_leading_data: The full leading-s coefficient is25*B56^2*(t^2-t-1)^10. Exact leading constants exclude only2,3,5,7,13,17 from the universal alternative lemma.
claims.positive_density: A joint unramified Frobenius43 class deranges all roots of A12,B56,G2. Chebotarev gives a positive-natural-density set of primes at which all affine Qp trace parameters s,t are integral. No field-independence assumption.
claims.boundary: The criterion applies to any discrete valuation with its residue-polynomial hypotheses. At a Q43-rational normalization point its local DVR has residue Q43; A and L have no Q43 roots, so the criterion forces both coordinate functions regular. Consequently no Q43 or rational normalization point lies on that coordinate boundary.
claims.nonvacuity: The complete F43 affine census has52 points,47 smooth, so infinitely many good Q43 models exist. The restriction is not local nonexistence.
